name: Shri Dinesh Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1935, Shri Dinesh Mills Ltd manufactures worsted fabrics (menswear), papermakers felts and industrial textiles[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Press Felts:
Dinflo, Dinvent, Dinply
b) Dryer Screens:
Hi Contact Mono (Regular), Hi Contact Mono (Uni-Screen), Spiral Dryer Fabrics
c) Fiber & Asbestos Felts:
Dinasorb-Pipe Felt, Dinasorb-Sheet Felt
d) Other Products:
Filter Fabrics

pros: Stock is trading at 0.78 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.5%
Debtor days have improved from 57.0 to 30.1 days.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -0.09% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.14% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.7.40 Cr.
